summary: From fiscal 2008 to 2025, VERTEX PHARMACEUTICALS INC / MA reported $73.2 billion of revenue and $16.4 billion of free cash flow. Stock pay was $5.6 billion, which leaves $10.9 billion of owner cash: 14.9% of revenue.
Owner cash was under 3.0% of revenue in 9 of 18 years.
